entities.name: Ulamog
entities.description: One of the three Eldrazi titans, the smallest and weakest, who consumes living and unliving matter; his name is half-remembered as the merfolk sea god Ula.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who arrives on Zendikar with Ulamog and Emrakul and later rebuffs the assault on Ulamog.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan who vanishes with Kozilek six months after the titans are released.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who helps trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar by inscribing hedrons with draconic runes.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker and Zendikar native who builds the hedron network and later reinforces the Eldrazi prison alone.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who helps imprison the Eldrazi by draining their strength.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Nahiri's home plane, where the Eldrazi were imprisoned and later released.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: The heart of the trap where the three planeswalkers converge to seal the titans.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The ravenous titans and their broods that consume mana and life energy.

entities.name: Hedron network
entities.description: A network of leylines, hedrons and mana nodes that lured and imprisoned the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The mountainous region where cultists infected by Ulamog loosened the Eldrazi prison.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped free the titans and later triggers the hedrons against Ulamog.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped free the titans and burns the leylines binding them.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker whose actions helped free the Eldrazi titans.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped free the titans and unearths hedrons around Sea Gate.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads the resistance army and wrestles Ulamog.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A planeswalker who leads armies with Gideon and Nissa.

entities.name: Jori En
entities.description: A Zendikari who travels with Jace and warns the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon planeswalker who disrupts the hedron network and reignites his spark.

entities.name: The Gatewatch
entities.description: The newly formed group of planeswalkers that rallies Zendikar's defenses and destroys Ulamog's material manifestation.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: A Zendikari city retaken from Ulamog's brood and site of the climactic battle.

entities.name: Slaughter at Sea Gate
entities.description: The massacre caused by Ulamog's brood after the titans' release.

entities.name: Imprisonment of the Eldrazi
entities.description: The planeswalkers' trapping of the Eldrazi titans on Zendikar in -1400 AR.

entities.name: Zhulodok, Void Gorger
entities.description: The only known named Ulamog brood Eldrazi.

events.summary: Ugin, Nahiri and Sorin devise a plan to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar with leylines and hedrons.
events.quote: They devised a plan to trap the Eldrazi by creating a complex network of leylines, hedrons and nodes of mana.

events.summary: The three Eldrazi titans arrive on Zendikar.
events.quote: descended upon Zendikar, their monstrous forms dwarfing everything in their path.

events.summary: The three planeswalkers activate the hedron network at the Eye of Ugin, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
events.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

events.summary: Cultists of Akoum loosen the Eldrazi prison and broods devastate Zendikar.
events.quote: their rituals proved effective in loosening the bonds of the Eldrazi prison.

events.summary: Twelve surviving cultists become the first vampire bloodchiefs, enslaved to Ulamog.
events.quote: those twelve became the first vampire bloodchiefs, the progenitors of the vampire race.

events.summary: Nahiri reinforces the prison on her own and leaves; the vampires are freed of Ulamog's yoke.
events.quote: After Nahiri enforced the Eldrazi prison all on her own, no more broods came to life.

events.summary: Jace, Chandra, Sarkhan and Nissa's actions free the Eldrazi titans.
Ulamog's brood causes the Slaughter at Sea Gate.
events.quote: Its brood caused the Slaughter at Sea Gate

events.summary: Emrakul and Kozilek vanish six months after release, leaving Ulamog to ravage Zendikar.
events.quote: Six months after they had been released, both Emrakul and Kozilek vanished, only leaving a few spawn behind.

events.summary: Jace dominates Jori En's mind to send her back to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.
events.quote: Jace dominated Jori En's mind to force her to leave him and return to warn the survivors of Ulamog's coming.

events.summary: The resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa and Kiora retakes Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.
events.quote: The Zendikar resistance army led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora assaulted and retook Sea Gate from Ulamog's brood.

events.summary: Gideon wrestles Ulamog while Nissa unearths hedrons and Jace triggers them, trapping the titan.
events.quote: Jace then triggered them, activating their latent magic and knocking the titan off balance while trapping him.

events.summary: Ob Nixilis knocks the hedrons out of alignment and reignites his spark.
events.quote: Everything looked to be smooth sailing until Ob Nixilis arrived, knocked the hedrons out of alignment, and positioned himself between them.

events.summary: Kozilek arrives and rebuffs Gideon's army.
events.quote: they were rebuffed by the arrival of a second titan: Kozilek

events.summary: The Gatewatch binds both titans in leylines and Chandra burns them, ending Ulamog's material manifestation on Zendikar.
events.quote: This was the end of the material manifestation of Ulamog on Zendikar.

events.summary: Eldrazi of Ulamog's brood attack the Infinite Guideline Station around 4564 AR.
events.quote: Eldrazi of what appeared to be Ulamog's brood attacked the Infinite Guideline Station and its occupants around 4564 AR

relations.note: One of the three Eldrazi titans.
relations.quote: one of the three Eldrazi titans

relations.note: They plan and build the Eldrazi trap together.
relations.quote: while Ugin inscribed them with draconic runes to hold them in place
led by Gideon, Nissa, and Kiora
The Gatewatch performed an orchestrated attack on both titans

relations.note: He disrupts and absorbs the network's magic.
relations.quote: knocked the hedrons out of alignment
